description:
Give AI agents spending power without giving them your wallet keys. Cloaked creates on-chain
spending accounts with enforced constraints that agents cannot bypass - even if jailbroken or compromised.

How it works: Create a Cloaked Agent on https://cloakedagent.com, set spending limits (per-tx, daily, lifetime), and give the agent key to your AI. The Solana program enforces all limits on-chain.

MCP Tools:
- cloak_balance - Check SOL and USDC balances with spending limits
- cloak_status - Agent health, constraints, and spending history
- cloak_pay - Send SOL or USDC within enforced limits
- cloak_x402_fetch - Fetch x402-protected content with automatic payment

Key features:
- On-chain enforced spending constraints (per-tx, daily, total, expiration)
- USDC token support with per-token limits
- ZK privacy mode - hide wallet-agent ownership link
- x402 protocol for autonomous pay-per-use APIs
- Instant freeze and real-time dashboard

Install:
npm install @cloakedagent/sdk

Links:
- Websi
